correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication in \(K[R_3]\) gives the three quadratic idempotent equations. Their sum yields \(s^2=s\), and pairwise differences factor as \((a-b)(s-1-3c)\) and its cyclic analogues. When characteristic is not three, these equations give exactly the eight listed solutions; in characteristic three, augmentation zero gives only zero while augmentation one reduces to \((a-b)^2=a+b\), yielding the stated affine-line parametrization. Independent enumeration over \(\mathbb F_2,\mathbb F_3,\mathbb F_5,\mathbb F_7\) matched the predicted counts, and the package separately checks \(\mathbb F_9\).
residual_risks: Finite-field checks are corroborative only; the arbitrary-field conclusion rests on the symbolic equations.
